systems.system: fichier national de l'identification civile and carte nationale d'identité informatisée, sécurisée et biométrique
systems.country_label: fichier national; carte nationale d'identité informatisée, sécurisée et biométrique
systems.owner: direction de l'identification civile, ministère de la sécurité et de l'ordre public (police nationale)
systems.tiers: central direction; production centres at Brazzaville, Pointe-Noire and Oyo covering all departments; departmental data-collection sections with antennas in arrondissements, districts and urban communities

systems.system: collaboration between the direction de l'identification civile and the civil status services
systems.country_label: collaboration avec les services de l'état civil
systems.tiers: data-collection antennas collect and authenticate civil status documents and gather deceased persons' identity documents from civil status services to update the identity database; no electronic link is described

note: Arrêtés 1888 and 1889 of 10 May 2022 organise the identity directorate and its card production centres; they describe an administrative hand-over of documents with the civil status services and say nothing of how a civil registration office records a birth or death.
